title: Janice
poem_text:
Like a darkly vibrant piece of mossy forestwood,
residing softly in an alpine grotto on
a warm winter day,
lush from snowmelt and
perfumed by witchy wintergreen,
its body a plush surface of 
moist velveteen,
enchanting the lips of a passing
satyr who stopped and took a sip, 
a lick,
then a kiss-
enchanting juices exuding from such
moist crevices erupted 
his hooves and phallus into 
a clamorous,
rapturous
bliss.

title: Paul
poem_text:
Thoughts without a trace,
Sounds without a scent…
such mystical conundrums are actually meant-
not to delude, 
nor to confuse- 
but rather, to remind us of the wisdom that leapt, 
before birth, 
out from the mouth of the Muse,
into infant brains innocent of intellect-
but whose seeds,
came to rest in the warm, fertile soil of our souls,
where all this time they’ve been
safely kept.
Pop goes the germinating shell,
taproot thrust from 
underworld.
